card.title: Humility with Evidence
card.instruction: Perform modesty while planting small facts that can later assemble themselves into undeniable proof of your importance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Anyone could have organised the concert. My thirty-seven calls were hardly heroic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only the completed ones. I wouldn't inflate the figure with attempts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, no. Just make sure whoever writes it has the call log.

mechanism: A denies heroism while supplying exact call counts and a log that can establish the organizing contribution.
confusable: Unlike straightforward credit-seeking, A must maintain modest denial while directing evidence toward recognition.
comparison: S234-b prepares the thank-you writer's proof; S234-a points minutes readers to many pages of personally paid invoices.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
